WITH group_avgs AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern`, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination 
    WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as overall_avg
    FROM group_avgs
),
kept_patterns AS (
    SELECT ga.`ANA Pattern`, ga.avg_acl_igg
    FROM group_avgs ga, overall_mean om
    WHERE ga.avg_acl_igg > om.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as kept_avg
    FROM kept_patterns
)
SELECT 
    kp.`ANA Pattern`,
    ROUND(kp.avg_acl_igg, 2) as avg_acl_igg,
    ROUND(kp.avg_acl_igg - om.overall_avg, 2) as above_overall_mean,
    ROUND(kp.avg_acl_igg - km.kept_avg, 2) as from_kept_mean_avg
FROM kept_patterns kp, overall_mean om, kept_mean km
ORDER BY kp.avg_acl_igg DESC
